title: P256 four-group early abort with expected-work ledger on the TBZ/BFI emission base

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using expected total work at most89991904692098669588038035394173749395625 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^126.081134739098625 group units at C1000; every run, all groups included, stays below2^126.238773 units (disclosed worst case). q1=377471015,q2=2^28,N=2^70. X indices form four contiguous groups ending at floor(q1*e/64), e=21,36,50,64, each transported as one hop1/hop2 phase; after each group a full rescan (prefix4c into a cursor copy, scatter, paired scanner, four-phase resolution with per-scan caps) runs, and a resolver-verified [x]P=Q stops the run by a tree broadcast. Group g's deterministic worst-path work is weighted by PHI[g], one minus the section-6 success lower bound at the previous group end, which bounds the probability that group g runs; one-time rows and the full meter cap are unweighted. Includes construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport with hop1 transaction-bound ACK and hop2 DONE-flag completion, grouping, resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^118units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification. Hop2 DONE markers plus per-group STLR signaling awaited via the barrier LDAXR/WFE primitive replace per-message acknowledgment and sender in-flight updates (14/11 receiver with d3/d4 inserted by BFI into its 2^30-aligned cursor-table and 2^51 counter base registers, 85/4 per potential record); the hop1 full flush is charged at its measured 581 (551 delivery, 10 in-flight, 19 publish, 1 reserve); the receive window is released only by the final flag load after all five packet words are in registers, so no mid-read publication can overwrite a packet; the first backward multiply preserves all four operand limbs (low pair by renaming its accumulator limbs to x1,x17; high pair by renaming the top accumulator limb to x28) and the second multiply omits both reloads; each inline record emission uses one TBZ full-window test on8192-byte-stride windows and two BFI field inserts in place of mask/add/or/test/branch (2501/4 per incidence, +1 per flush firing in the hop1 row); the candidate cap is2^24 with its Markov loss charged and q1 re-optimized; the range scan forms its dispatch index with one UBFX (25 per range); cold scalar multiplications (generator items and the resolver's verification) are charged as an itemized Jacobian double-and-add ladder with one inversion (1315823 each, 1024-instruction wrapper per point operation) instead of 512 affine operations; DONE publication/handling/wait in the per-group fixed term.
